Headline: Notion rolls out AI-powered meeting notes
Summary: Notion launched an AI feature that auto-generates meeting notes and action items inside docs. Available first to Business and Enterprise plans.

Headline: Linear raises new growth round
Summary: Linear closed a new funding round to expand its enterprise roadmap and grow its go-to-market team internationally.

Headline: ClickUp partners with Zoom
Summary: ClickUp announced a native Zoom integration letting users start and log meetings directly from tasks.

Headline: Asana appoints new VP of Product
Summary: Asana named a new VP of Product to lead its AI initiatives, signaling a stronger push into AI-assisted work management.

Headline: Notion launches new brand campaign
Summary: Notion kicked off a global ad campaign positioning itself as the 'connected workspace' for modern teams.

Headline: Linear ships customer requests triage view
Summary: Linear released a new triage view to help teams turn customer feedback into prioritized product work faster.
